title: @dogtrax@mastodon.social in the thickness of my umbra truths cast shadows of doubt with each step in the interstices shadow blisters bouncing converge
summary: @dogtrax@mastodon.social in the thickness of my umbra truths cast shadows of doubt with each step in the interstices shadow blisters bouncing convergence of understanding as light bends reality before approaching dawn of darkness #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
@dogtrax@mastodon.social
in the thickness of
my umbra
truths cast shadows of doubt
with each step in the
interstices
shadow blisters bouncing
convergence of understanding
as light bends reality
before approaching
dawn of darkness
#smallpoems
